# InVet Command: plan-task

Equivalent to OpenCode `/plan-task`.

Input: `BE-00X`, `FE-00X`, or `QA-00X`.

Use agent: `InVet Product Planner`.

Before acting, read:

- `.opencode/commands/plan-task.md`
- `.opencode/agents/invet-product-planner.md`
- `docs/opencode/templates/slice_plan_template.md`
- `docs/opencode/14_github_copilot_agentic_flow.md`

Create or repair the canonical schema v3 plan and required `US/UIA/APIA` artifacts. Do not implement source code.
